package externalnode

import "example.com/ridu-gate1/field"

type customNode struct{}

func (customNode) Name() string           { return "custom" }
func (customNode) Kind() field.Kind       { return field.TextKind }
func (customNode) Children() field.Fields { return nil }
func (n customNode) snapshot() field.Node { return field.Text(n.Name()) }

// A same-spelled unexported method in this package cannot impersonate field's
// ownership boundary. Consumers use concrete nodes and public graph edits.
var _ field.Node = customNode{}
